title: Persist provider acceptance and hold unresolved retries beyond Resend retention
detail:
DRAFT: actual generic/Space email worker supplies trusted claimed queue ID; sender activates service-only prepare/settle ledger via EMAIL_PROVIDER_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED, default off. Persist immutable provider payload, stable SDK key, first-attempt time/nonce, accepted ID and honest rejected/uncertain state. Lost local acceptance writes replay same key; accepted ledger skips provider; old unknowns hold at 23h conservatively inside Resend 24h retention. Unknown acceptance survives subsequent refusals; no exactly-once promise. Invalid payload/permanent rejection/uncertainty hold becomes visible DLQ without automatic retry. Atomic bridge messages project queued->sent/failed in settlement transaction. Migration077 CLI-generated then dependency-renumbered; no DB application. SQL/crash/concurrency and all direct caller cutover/campaign projection evidence incomplete. No live send. Root owns grant inventories/generated types. Prepare stamps sticky per-job acceptance requirement; toggling the rollout flag off never bypasses that ledger for previously attempted jobs. Do not remove consumer support or markers while attempts remain unresolved. Main-target draft depends on PR3364 migration076 for the atomic intent/message projection inside settlement; this PR intentionally contains no EMAIL-002/004 row or migration076. Source permission catalogs include the provider table and all three service-only RPCs. Known accepted acknowledgements recover before config/suppression checks; missing provider config keeps a durable job pending; prior uncertainty followed by a permanent refusal remains held and does not project definitive failure. Migration077 and RLS/service-role consequences remain unexecuted. No auto-merge or producer activation. CI repair: provider ledger RPC authority resides at existing queue service boundary, with an actual processing-email job lookup, pinned queue ID and restricted operation names; acceptance helper adds no service-role importer or guard waiver. 49 focused provider/queue tests pass, authz/admin-client guards pass. Source-derived077 table/RPC declarations match unapplied draft SQL; no live regeneration/application claim. Actual database CI and main prerequisite3364 remain required.

META-SCAN 2026-10-12. Migration 20270346007700 is applied in production. Flag now read through envFlag; the email-delivery-contract probe no longer sets the never-read EMAIL_DISPATCH_POLICY_ENABLED. Activation gate documented in docs/RUNBOOKS.md. Live posture read 2026-10-12 (read-only SQL): RLS on for all eight email tables; email_delivery_intents, email_provider_attempts, space_email_domain_operations, space_email_reply_aliases and space_email_reply_quarantine grant nothing to anon or authenticated and carry no policy (service only); space_email_domains, space_email_identities and space_email_identity_defaults are SELECT-only for authenticated under one policy each; enqueue_conversation_email_intent, prepare/settle/read_accepted_email_provider_attempt and claim_space_email_domain_operation execute for service_role only.

verify.evidence: OPEN: source/mocked boundary tests are not SQL proof. Execute isolated migration/projection/race/timeout consequences, classify every direct sender before activation, demonstrate accepted provider IDs linked to every path, fault after acceptance, and >24h uncertainty hold; retain evidence and never reset unresolved attempt age on replay.
